slug: 2025-02-13 Digital ID necessity increases in Nigeria despite lingering challenges

facts.fact: The NCC claimed in October 2024 that all active SIM cards in Nigeria had been identified and linked to the digital ID, per the article.
Nigeria is using the NIN to build a social register for distributing government cash support, and plans a farmers register.
The Secretary to the Government announced that access to all social services would henceforth be mandatorily tied to the NIN.
The article reports NIN linkage for SIM registration (telecoms) and a NIN requirement for social services and a social register (social protection).
